status: registered before one final Memoria-only retest after reproduced interval precision and uncited value binding defects
concurrency_scope: Only the final Memoria framework; two isolated histories in parallel, questions serial within history.
baseline: Full visible conversation before question; drop oldest whole turns only if byte/window budget exceeded. Record every truncation.
memoria: Bounded diverse source-channel fusion; typed requirement/source bindings before sufficiency aggregation; source-only Reader context; one budgeted minimal answer repair followed by full independent support verification.
judge: Independent binary LLM with frozen adapted permissive rubric; no arm label or evidence override. Gold used only after answering.
failure_policy: Planned IDs stay in denominator; unknown judge coverage and answer errors are separate. No filtered-accuracy promotion.
accounting: Every formation, consolidation, Reader, support, repair and grading call. Shared ingestion once per visible-history hash. Missing usage stays unknown; retained upper reservation is not an invoice.
resume: Not implemented. Keep checkpoints, isolated databases and append-only calls. New execution is a new charged run.
interpretation_limits: Repeated development sample; no unseen generalization or new full-data claim.
Single framework group; no simultaneous control or isolated causal attribution.
Input now includes separate dataset-provided machine image captions, so paired score changes combine input completeness and algorithm changes.
Question names, ambiguous date/count scope and personal-identity absence remain unresolved; gold and original grading rubric are unchanged.
Official source ID presence is post-hoc visibility, not semantic sufficiency; compound locator normalization differs from old v13 exports.
billing_policy: Two consecutive insufficient-balance responses open a global circuit; retain every planned ID as not_run. No automatic top-up or retry.
authorization: User requested substantial improvements, the original 36 questions and GitHub push. Internal mechanism diagnostics are allowed, but the final reported group must be Memoria only.

sampling.method: first two histories; four uniformly sampled questions per category per history; no answer/gold/failure filters

additional_changes: Preserve complementary top-channel candidates within the original candidate limit; RRF remains a ranking signal, never a sufficiency label.
Question-only typed targets, original quote bindings, separate conservative completeness aggregation and same-source relative-year arithmetic hints.
Exclude unclosed observation summaries from Reader evidence while retaining reviewed-memory routing receipts and dependencies.
One minimal answer repair may remove unsupported optional claims, only if complete Reader and support verification fit the existing shared case budget; no added retrieval or hidden HTTP retries.
Separate strictly templated source-clock statements from event-date claims; original event and same-ID calendar support are still required for event dates.
Dataset-provided BLIP caption text is imported as a separate explicitly machine-generated source with no event clock; no image generation, OCR or guessed image content.
Post-hoc compound official locator IDs are parsed separately; old run files, original gold, scores and unknown failures are immutable.
Interval answer precision is separate from the calendar date used to locate that week/month/year.
Explicit attribute/object value words must be bound to actually cited original text, never borrowed from an uncited memory hint.
Source clocks can date literal proposals/agreements when the question asks for that speech/decision event, never the future activity or a previously reported physical event.
Reader/citation summary visibility is measured from the actual projected packet and published provenance, not retained routing candidates.
budget_note: One complete final Memoria-only 36-case retest after concrete regressions found in v14; no selected-case retries. All prior v14 predictions/failures/costs remain private immutable history. Same 8-call/240000-byte/8000-char case caps.
